title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
authors: Yuhan Liu; Yihua Cheng; Jiayi Yao; Yuwei An; Xiaokun Chen; Shaoting Feng; Yuyang Huang; Samuel Shen; Rui Zhang; Kuntai Du; Junchen Jiang
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: KV cache size in modern LLM inference has grown to exceed GPU memory capacity, and existing solutions lack efficient mechanisms for offloading, transferring, and managing these caches across distributed engines.
problem_statement.zh: 現代 LLM 推理的 KV cache 體積已超出 GPU 記憶體容量，而現有方案缺乏高效的 KV cache 卸載、傳輸與跨分散式引擎管理機制。

key_innovation.en: LMCache, a unified KV caching layer that treats KV cache as a first-class data structure, featuring batched data movement, compute-I/O pipelining, and a modular connector interface for compatibility with evolving inference engines.
key_innovation.zh: LMCache 是一個統一的 KV caching 層，將 KV cache 視為一等公民資料結構，提供批次資料移動、計算與 I/O 流水線化，以及模組化連接器介面，以相容於持續演進的推理引擎。

key_improvements.en: Up to 15x throughput increase, 1.9-8.1x lower TTFT, and 7-92% lower ITL compared to baselines.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量最高提升 15x，TTFT 降低 1.9–8.1x，ITL 降低 7–92%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, Context Caching
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, B200, AMD GPU, Ascend, TPU
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; reports throughput/TTFT/ITL speedup rather than predictive error)
models_validated: Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen2.5-32B (production traces of enterprise workloads)
validation_workloads: Production trace (enterprise reuse-heavy workloads), Synthetic, ShareGPT

scope_assumptions.en: Treats KV cache as a first-class data structure with batched movement and compute–I/O pipelining; empirical model of per-user reuse distributions on enterprise workloads reports more than 19% of users reusing stored tokens more than 1.5 times. The paper does not publish a closed-form analytical predictor for TTFT/ITL — performance gains are characterized empirically via large-scale production traces and tiered (GPU↔CPU↔SSD↔Redis) latency measurements.
scope_assumptions.zh: 將 KV cache 視為一等公民資料結構，提供批次資料移動與 compute–I/O 流水線化；在企業流量上實測，每名使用者重用儲存 token 超過 1.5 次的比例高於 19%。論文並未發表 TTFT/ITL 的 closed-form 解析預測器，效能增益是透過大規模生產流量與 GPU↔CPU↔SSD↔Redis tiered latency 量測進行實證刻畫。

offload_trigger: After computation: the storage manager saves KV of tokens not yet in the backend, per layer (layer-wise mode) or after the scheduling iteration; dynamic offloading additionally duplicates free GPU pages to CPU memory proactively, and decode-generated KV is stored in delayed batches.
destination_tiers: HBM, host DRAM, local SSD, remote DRAM pool, remote SSD, disaggregated store
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive on request arrival with queue-aware prefetching: KV of an admitted-but-queued query is prefetched from slower tiers to a faster target tier during the queueing interval; loading into GPU is pipelined layer-wise on separate CUDA streams, overlapping transfer with computation.
agent_awareness: Exploits prefix reuse across queries (context caching): multi-turn dialogues, fixed system prompts, document analysis, RAG and coding-assistant histories; no tool-call-gap or workflow-graph exploitation (agentic workloads only as outlook).

when_to_offload_rule.en: Store the KV cache of tokens not already present in the backend to lower-tier storage immediately after they are computed (layer-wise or per scheduling iteration), except during decoding, where storing is delayed and batched until a predefined chunk of new tokens has accumulated.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於運算完成後，即將 backend 中尚未存有之 token 的 KV cache 卸載至較低層級儲存（依 layer 或依排程迭代觸發）；惟於 decode 階段採延遲批次策略，待新生成 token 累積至預定 chunk 數量後方進行批次寫入。
